svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.10.4 Location of Fuel-Fired Appliances
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.10.4 Location of Fuel-Fired Appliances
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Location of Fuel-Fired Appliances

g.text: Fuel-fired appliances in a service room
Appliance serving not more than one room
or suite: need not be in a separated
Building of not more than 400 m² (4 306 ft²)
and not more than 2 storeys: appliances
need not be in a separated service room
House with a secondary suite: service room
rated not less than the fire separation

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Fuel-fired appliances are located in a service
room separated from the remainder of the building
by a fire separation having not less than a 1 h
fire-resistance rating
Except as provided in Sentences (2) and (3) and
Article 9.10.10.5.
Fuel-fired space-heating appliances,
space-cooling appliances, service water heaters
and laundry appliances need not be separated as
required in Sentence (1)
(a) where the appliances serve (i) not more than one
room or suite, or (ii) a building with a building
area of not more than 400 m² (4 306 ft²) and a
building height of not more than 2 storeys, or (b)
where the appliances (i) serve a house with a
secondary suite including their common spaces, and
(ii) are in a service room separated from the
dwelling units or their common spaces by a fire
separation rated not less than that required between
the dwelling units or common spaces. Except as
required in the appliance installation standards
referenced in Sentences 6.2.1.5.(1), 9.33.5.2.(1)
Sentence (1) does not apply to fireplaces and
cooking appliances
Drawn: plans cut low and slices. Red: fire separations. Grey boxes: furnaces. Cylinders: water heaters. Sentence (3) is in the panel.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.10.4. (page 9-74)
